summary: The pinned candidate and frozen evidence support the scoped software and POSIX PTY checks. The bundle and evidence hashes match their recorded values; the isolated checkout is at the pinned commit.
accepted_scope: 921600 defaults and serial support, supported and invalid baud handling, manifest schema validation, full-stack build, deploy CLI/config behavior, sim and PTY-backed hardware startup, missing-UART rejection, failed-health-check cleanup, and repeated start/stop recovery. Cross-compiler ELF builds and physical MCU USB/UART HIL are excluded by the contract and are not proven by this software audit.
